title: Double Drip 10K Strawberry Ice Prefilled Vape Pods + Refill
description: This Pod & Refill Pack is made for use with the Double Drip 10K Prefilled Pod Kit, offering a simple and mess-free way to refresh your flavour. It includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml bottle of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, providing up to 10,000 puffs per pack (depending on use) with smooth vapour delivery and consistent flavour. Strawberry Ice brings together sweet, sun-ripened Strawberry with a brisk Menthol chill. The result is a classic fruit-and-ice combo that’s bright, balanced, and perfect for vapers who enjoy a fresh edge to their fruity vapes. To swap flavours or refill your device, just replace the pod and bottle and let the built-in auto-refill system keep the vape flowing.
